source.subject: feat: route whole-chunk full-attention FP8 Prefill

frozen_baseline_binary.role: production C512 binary with bulk causal GQA, whole-chunk NVFP4 Down, and whole-chunk FP8 linear-attention QKV/Z/O routes, before the full-attention Q/K/V projection promotion
frozen_baseline_binary.source_scope_note: This is the candidate binary measured by the preceding FP8 whole-chunk production record. It is the frozen comparator here; later test-only full-attention screen code did not change its production route.

environment.claim_scope: one fixed-clock Jetson AGX Orin, one pinned checkpoint, batch one, output one, and direct native-runner timing

selected_shapes.role: full-attention K and V shared shape

production_route.selected_kernel: one fixed whole-chunk grid, 256 threads, M64-by-N128 logical CTA arithmetic, with token-count-specific tile order for K/V

replaced_routes.q_c512: sixteen ordered production M32 kernels per full-attention layer
replaced_routes.k_c512: sixty-four ordered production M8 CUDA kernels per full-attention layer
replaced_routes.v_c512: sixty-four ordered production M8 CUDA kernels per full-attention layer

p513_theoretical_projection_nodes.note: The 2,304-node value follows the exact previous Q-M32 and K/V-M8 launch contracts across 16 full-attention layers. The 48-node candidate count is confirmed by the fresh production Nsight profile.

production_route.eligibility: exact C256/C512, selected SM87 backend, exact full-attention Q or K/V shape, 16-byte weight alignment, 8-byte input alignment, 2-byte output alignment, and a complete valid Fp8LinearWeight payload
production_route.payload_contract: Both device companion-scale pointers remain mandatory and are validated even though the whole-chunk kernel consumes the validated host weight scale directly.
production_route.fallback: Structural and production-alignment near misses return cudaErrorNotSupported before enqueue and retain the established tiled route. Malformed scalar, pointer, byte-range, or alias contracts return cudaErrorInvalidValue without fallback or enqueue.
production_route.other_routes: Bulk causal GQA, linear-attention QKV/Z, attention output, NVFP4 Down, C64/C32/tail projection schedules, BF16 projections, and every other shape retain their prior routes.

prerequisite_screen.c256_k_v_layout_decision: M-major is selected because the 32-CTA grid underfills the device and is slightly faster than the otherwise identical N-major control in both distributions.
prerequisite_screen.correctness: Q is bitwise equal to production M32; K/V pass the production M8 tolerance gate and are bitwise equal across the selected/control/replay routes; exhaustive E4M3FN, classified-NaN, guard, input, Graph, invalid-call, alias, and resource gates pass.

formal_protocol.prompt_construction: P(N) uses N-12 space-separated copies of ASCII hello and the pinned non-thinking single-user chat template.
formal_protocol.comparison: arithmetic mean of mirrored process medians: B=(B1+B2)/2 and C=(C1+C2)/2
formal_protocol.prefix_definition: all prompt tokens except the final prompt token and LM head

formal_results.route: one exact C256 prefix tile; full Q is N-major and K/V are M-major
one exact C512 prefix tile; full Q/K/V are N-major

streaming_canonical_extraction.method: For each B1/C1/C2/B2 log, stream lines matching ^(status|projection\.backend|prefill\.(requested|effective)_chunk_size|benchmark\.(prompt_count|max_new_tokens|stop_token_id)|prompt\.[01]\.(prompt_ids|generated_ids|generated_text|stop_reason|step_count|steps))= through SHA-256.

correctness.full_reference_oracle: pass: 19 prompt IDs, 26 generated IDs, exact text, im_end, and 44 steps on the SM87 backend
correctness.dispatch_contract: pass: exact full-attention Q and K/V C256/C512 each capture as one production whole-chunk kernel; function identity locks Q to N-major, C256 K/V to M-major, and C512 K/V to N-major; near misses retain fallback or reject before enqueue according to the public contract
correctness.screen_replay_contract: pass: the prerequisite production-unreachable screen covers Q/K/V finite and exhaustive replay, Graph, guards, inputs, aliases, and invalid capture. The production real-storage replay fixture remains the existing linear-attention QKV shape, so no separate production-real-storage replay claim is made for each new Q/K/V shape.
correctness.host_selector_contract: pass: selects exact aligned full-attention Q/K/V C256/C512, rejects backend/token/shape/type/alignment near misses, and leaves malformed companion pointers to runtime validation

memory.assessment: Both candidate processes report zero persistent drop. Baseline B1 reports a 66,441,216-byte persistent drop, 667,648 bytes below the 64-MiB tolerance, so persistent_drop_detected remains false. The promoted route changes launch topology only and adds no sidecar, request workspace, persistent allocation, or buffering tier.

nsight_p513_c512.protocol: candidate production binary, one tokenizer-pinned P513 single-generate process, output one, C512, SM87 backend, NVTX phase ranges enabled, and no warmup; diagnostic topology and attribution rather than the formal latency distribution

remaining_prefix_hotspots.streaming: serial on the single observed Prefix stream

nsight_p513_c512.interpretation: The exact Q and shared K/V kernel rows confirm one Q, one K, and one V whole-chunk projection in each of 16 full-attention layers. The 2,304-to-48 node reduction exactly explains the 2,256-op Prefix profile reduction; the projection-time and Prefix-wall gains also include decoded-weight reuse and are not attributed to launch overhead alone. All 10,129 Prefix GPU operations remain on one stream. Gate/Up is the largest residual hotspot at 2,048 serial launches and 39.199622% of the projected Prefix span, which makes production integration of the already-selected whole-chunk main/aux-stream pair the next bounded step.

external_reference.accounting: P divided by scheduled-to-first-token for stock vLLM and P divided by native TTFT for this candidate
external_reference.stock_vllm_backend: FlashInfer for 16 full-attention layers, Triton/FLA GDN Prefill for 48 linear-attention layers, and Marlin FP8/NVFP4 projections
external_reference.interpretation: This is a matched batch-one/output-one directional reference, not a same-binary benchmark. The promoted native route narrows the measured stock-vLLM gap to about 2.64x-2.83x, but is not claimed to approach the user's separately tuned 2k-8k token/s vLLM result.

decision.result: promote exact aligned C256/C512 FP8 full-attention Q, K, and V whole-chunk routes
decision.why: All runtime, dispatch, model, memory, and fresh-profile gates pass. Against the frozen current-production binary, the narrow production delta improves mirrored Prefix by 1.05438x at P257 and 1.05511x at P513, improves TTFT by 1.05113x and 1.05342x, and Nsight confirms all 48 eligible full-attention projections use one whole-chunk grid instead of the previous 2,304 nodes.
decision.retained_boundaries: The generic projection limit remains C64; unsupported cases preserve established fallback; Decode, default C1, public ABI, request workspace, persistent allocation, MTP policy, and Prefill/Decode execution ownership are unchanged.
decision.next_priority: The fresh Prefix trace places all 10,129 GPU operations on one stream and assigns 1,346.373984 ms, 2,048 serial launches, and 39.199622% of projected Prefix time to Gate/Up. Integrate the already-screened C512 whole-chunk main/aux-stream pair behind a narrow production route and run its exact model, memory, mirrored latency, and fresh-profile gates; then evaluate C1024 as a test-only internal route before considering any public boundary change.

limitations: The formal result is batch one, max1, one checkpoint, one Orin, fixed clocks, and mirrored process medians; it is not concurrent serving throughput, a latency-tail, power, or energy result.

Native Prefix excludes the final prompt token and LM head. Complete-prompt P/TTFT is the directional cross-framework accounting, but native and vLLM remain independent runtime measurements rather than a same-binary trial.

The native candidate reaches 141.273450981 and 145.327508146 complete-prompt token/s at P257/P513. It remains 2.644368049x and 2.830744195x behind the measured stock vLLM reference and is not claimed to be near the user's separately tuned 2k-8k token/s range.

Baseline B1 reports a nonzero 66,441,216-byte persistent free-memory decrease. It remains 667,648 bytes below the declared tolerance and does not trigger the benchmark failure contract; both candidate processes and B2 report zero persistent drop.
FlashInfer, MTP, continuous batching, double/triple buffering, Prefill/Decode overlap, and an OpenAI-compatible server are not used or introduced.
The fresh Nsight report is one no-warmup diagnostic process. Its route topology is authoritative for that trace; the formal B1-C1-C2-B2 logs remain authoritative for latency.
